rows.text: Conflicts in cyberspace are always more complicated than imagined. Hackers skip and leap across each other's paths in digital space and any perceived disadvantages by one side would result in them scurrying from the scene, thus drawing out all combat to infinite durations. In Punklorde, where aether editing was created, the legendary hacker Stoneblade fought his nemesis for fourteen summers, never truly achieving victory or suffering defeat. In the end, he concocted an aether encryption key with a uni-directional locking function, teleporting himself to his opponent's physical position, and ended this rivalry that spanned more than a decade, face-to-face.
